title_sq: Ne Kompleksin "Colonnade", Prane Zogut Te Zi, Shitet Apartament 3+1+2 Me Hapsira Te Bollshme !!
description_sq: Ne Kompleksin "Colonnade", Prane Zogut Te Zi, Shitet Apartament 3+1+2, me siperfaqe totale 140.4 m2. Ndodhet ne katin e 3-te banim te nje super projekti ne ndertim, aktualisht ne faze fasade. Organizohet me korridorin qe ben shperndarjen e ambientit te ndenjes me siperfaqe te bollshme se bashku me kendin e gatimit dhe ballkonin, dhome gjumi matrimoniale me tualet dhe ballkon me vete, dy dhomat e femijeve dhe tualeti i dites. Shume prane Qendres se Tiranes, ky projekt ka si qellim rivitalizimin e zones me element te arkitektures moderne.
title_en: In the "Colonnade" complex, near the Black Bird, 3+1+2 apartment for sale with ample spaces!!
description_en: In the "Colonnade" Complex, near Zogut Te Black, Apartment 3+1+2 for sale, with a total area of ​​140.4 m2. It is located on the 3rd residential floor of a super project under construction, currently in the facade phase. It is organized with the corridor that divides the living room with ample surface area together with the kitchen corner and the balcony, the matrimonial bedroom with its own toilet and balcony, the two children's rooms and the day toilet. Very close to the Center of Tirana, this project aims to revitalize the area with elements of modern architecture.
